lemmas.primary_translation: to earn back money lost or spent on buying something

definitions.text: få inn tilsvarende pengesum som en har tapt eller brukt på å kjøpe noe
definitions.translation: to bring in an amount of money equal to what one has lost or spent on buying something

examples.no: investeringene var tjent inn etter omtrent et år
examples.en: The investments had paid for themselves after about a year.
